button.label: Wrap
button.supertip: Choose whether to wrap the selection by reusing a wrapper formula from another cell or by typing a formula pattern with [value].

button.label: Static Sheet/WB
button.supertip: Permanently replaces all formulas with their current values across the active sheet or the entire workbook. Handles spill ranges correctly.

button.label: Clean Data
button.supertip: Trims spaces and removes non-printable characters for the selected scope (Range, Sheet, or Workbook).

menu.label: Modify Data
menu.supertip: Modifies text and dates in the selection (casing or date standardization).

button.label: Date Fixer
button.supertip: Standardizes dates in the selection.

button.label: Case Fixer
button.supertip: Standardizes casing of text in the selection.

button.label: Unmerge FillDown
button.supertip: Unmerges the selected cells and fills the parent value to all unmerged cells.

button.label: Convert Text to Number
button.supertip: Forces text-formatted numbers in the selection to become actual numeric values.

menu.label: Highlight Data
menu.supertip: Highlights key data patterns and duplicates.

button.label: Inconsistent Formulas
button.supertip: Highlights inconsistent formulas in yellow.

button.label: Duplicates
button.supertip: Highlights duplicate values in soft red.

button.label: Errors
button.supertip: Highlights cells with errors in orange.

button.label: Hardcoded Values
button.supertip: Highlights formulas containing hardcoded values in lavender.

button.label: Data Validations
button.supertip: Highlights cells with data validation rules in soft green.

button.label: Conditional Formatting
button.supertip: Highlights cells with conditional formatting in soft blue.

button.label: Financial Modelling
button.supertip: Formats cells using the standard financial model coloring scheme.

button.label: Clear Highlights
button.supertip: Clears all cells in the workbook matching the highlight color.

button.label: Break Links
button.supertip: Removes all external workbook references and keeps current values.

button.label: Duplicate Workbook
button.supertip: Duplicates the active workbook to your Desktop, opens it, and closes the original so you can work safely on the copy.

menu.label: Export
menu.supertip: Exports the selected range as a PNG image or a PDF document.

button.label: Export as PNG
button.supertip: Exports the selected range as a PNG image.

button.label: Export as PDF
button.supertip: Exports the selected range as a PDF document.

button.label: Table of Contents
button.supertip: Creates a hyperlinked index sheet at the beginning of the workbook.

button.label: Help Center
button.supertip: Opens the Beaver Help Center, listing all registered hotkeys, user-defined functions, and their descriptions.

button.label: Hello World
button.supertip: Puts 'Hello world' into the active cell (metadata test).
